project_name: IU Digital de Antioquia - Analytics Platform
emotional_tone: Executive, trustworthy, modern, data-dense, academic, institutional.

headings.instruction: Used for page titles, KPI numbers, and widget headers. Never use Inter.

body.instruction: Optimal for data-dense tables, lists, and analytical tooltips.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID

surfaces.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/80 border-b border-border

components_strategy.buttons: Flat, sharp edges or max 4px radius. High contrast text on hover.
components_strategy.tables: Dense. text-sm. 1px bottom border for rows. No vertical borders inside tables. sticky headers.
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn UI Form, Input, Select. Floating labels or top labels (text-xs uppercase).
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Minimal axes. Use tooltips. Maintain brand chart_palette.
components_strategy.filters: Sidebar multi-dimensional filter using Accordion + Checkboxes/Selects from Shadcn.
components_strategy.map: Leaflet + react-leaflet. Use minimal tile layer (e.g., CartoDB Positron) to let data points (heatmaps/markers in brand colors) stand out.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle border color darkening. Interactive elements must change background.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Skeleton loaders matching widget dimensions. No generic spinners for full page.

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button')

login_background.description: Abstract architectural interior of a modern university library in Colombia, warm natural lighting, minimalist.
login_background.placement: Login page split screen right side background.

data_abstract_bg.description: Abstract data visualization background, elegant nodes and connections.
data_abstract_bg.placement: Hero banner for Executive Dashboard or PDF Cover page header.

campus_students.description: Students walk by a campus building under a tree.
campus_students.placement: Optional contextual image for profile or empty states.

colombia_map_concept.description: Close-up of a marked map of Central America/Colombia.
colombia_map_concept.placement: Empty state or loading background for the Territorial Dashboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use purely Shadcn UI, customized for dense data (reduce paddings in tables and cards). Do not use generic card shadows, use flat 1px borders.
Implement a persistent left or right sidebar for the multi-dimensional global filters.
For the map, ensure react-leaflet is used with a dark/light minimalist tile set so the DIVIPOLA data points stand out.
Always apply data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
Prioritize optical alignment and the 'Control Room' dense grid logic. No excessive whitespace in the BI views.
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is applied to KPI numbers and dashboard headers to convey institutional authority.
Color palette is based on IU Digital de Antioquia's institutional identity (Blue, Red, Yellow) adapted for UI data viz.
